intent.raw: refine the retry and domain interaction ideas until we have an exact RWO recovery model
intent.objective: Produce an exact, evidence-bounded, non-executed recovery model that distinguishes delivery, run, attempt, repeat, replay, reconciliation, compensation, and escalation while preserving domain, RWO, ARE, ACI, and exact-effect owner boundaries.
intent.operator_sentence: Refine these ideas and get to an exact model.

route_menu.context_hint: The target already has accepted current-state research and a materialized explanatory ontology, but lacks an exact recovery classifier and domain mapping contract.

items.label: Full exact recovery model
items.description: Model identity, state, precedence, ownership, ARE boundaries, counterexamples, and a non-executed implementation plan.
items.pattern: sequence with dialectic, tournament, x-ray, and toy-game overlays

items.label: Kernel-only retry model
items.description: Limit the result to RWO attempt scheduling and omit domain mapping and effect reconciliation.

items.label: Ontology-only extension
items.description: Add candidate concepts without first proving the exact operational model.
items.pattern: deferred because design ownership must precede ontology promotion

technique_overlays.trigger: The fixed ten-stage Refine loop must preserve ordered evidence and owner-held artifacts.
technique_overlays.validation_expectation: Every stage consumes prior evidence, emits an owned artifact or receipt, preserves owner boundaries, and records missing evidence as residue or a block.

technique_overlays.trigger: Domain meaning, RWO lifecycle scheduling, semantic reasoning, and effect authority are competing concerns that must remain separate through critique.
technique_overlays.validation_expectation: Named roles challenge one another and converge only when the model preserves identity and owner boundaries; unresolved disagreement remains explicit residue.

technique_overlays.trigger: Several plausible classifier placements, state machines, and policy boundaries must be compared before selecting the smallest coherent model.
technique_overlays.validation_expectation: Alternatives are compared on determinism, ownership, safety, implementability, and compatibility; rejected candidates and recomposition proof are recorded.

technique_overlays.trigger: The main uncertainty is the hidden relationship among delivery, WorkRun, Attempt, repeat round, replay, and effect identities.
technique_overlays.validation_expectation: The context and design artifacts expose each identity, component, relationship, transition, and owner as a consumable handle.

technique_overlays.trigger: Unsafe retry rules can be rejected cheaply with bounded scenarios before any design, ontology, or runtime mutation.
technique_overlays.validation_expectation: Every named scenario selects one safe disposition or an explicit fail-closed owner; payment outcome unknown must never automatically retry.

technique_overlays.trigger: The source set includes private ARE and ACI candidate material that may inform boundaries but cannot become public or canonical by copying.
technique_overlays.validation_expectation: Private evidence remains referenced and bounded; the RWO model stays system-agnostic and grants no ARE, ACI, effect, or promotion authority.

subagent_strategy.trigger: One isolated adversarial review can falsify retry-safety and authority assumptions without creating a multi-agent governed dispatch.
subagent_strategy.explanation: The parent Refine run owns state-model and domain-boundary synthesis. One bounded helper independently attacks the design after Invoke Design and returns only an artifact and lifecycle receipt. Helper failure becomes residue and cannot be upgraded to a pass.

roles.purpose: Falsify unsafe equivalences, ambiguous identity transitions, authority collapse, and unknown-effect retry behavior in the candidate exact model.
roles.owns: An independent adversarial report and no architecture, ontology, runtime, or authority decision.

subagent_strategy.permission_prompt: Confirm the Refine run and the single bounded adversarial helper?

agents.residue: 15 findings and 11 repairs were consumed by s07 and s08

steps.name: Context Builder evidence baseline
stop_conditions: Block if current RWO, ontology, accepted findings, or private bridge boundaries cannot be represented without crossing ownership or privacy boundaries.

steps.name: Invoke Define
stop_conditions: Block if retry, redelivery, repeat, replay, revalidation, reconciliation, or compensation are treated as synonyms.

steps.name: Interrogation refine-review
convergence_criteria: Every identity boundary has one owner and no overloaded state transition.
Domain meaning, RWO scheduling, ARE reasoning, and exact-effect authority remain distinct.
Unresolved contradictions are recorded with an owner instead of synthesized away.
stop_conditions: Block if the definition cannot state what remains the same and what changes for each recovery treatment.

steps.name: Research decision
stop_conditions: Do not perform external research unless a named gap exists and the operator separately confirms a bounded pass.

steps.name: Distill coherent recovery unit
stop_conditions: Block if the selected unit cannot recompose into domain mapping, RWO lifecycle, journal history, ARE reasoning, and effect handling without owner collapse.

steps.name: Invoke Redefine and Design exact model
convergence_criteria: The selected model is deterministic from typed facts, declared policy, and accepted history.
The model has a closed disposition vocabulary and exact identity-transition semantics.
The model preserves owner boundaries and explains why rejected alternatives fail.
The model recomposes into the existing RWO architecture without claiming implementation.
stop_conditions: Block if no candidate survives determinism, unknown-effect safety, owner separation, and recomposition criteria.

steps.name: Interrogation refine-design-review
convergence_criteria: Each scenario produces one disposition or a typed fail-closed escalation.
Unknown external effect, stale observations, replay, and changed authority cannot cross unsafe transitions.
All challenged claims are linked to a source, invariant, fixture, or explicit open owner decision.
stop_conditions: Block if the adversarial receipt is absent without an explicit helper lifecycle block, or if any critical counterexample remains unsafe.

steps.name: Distill Repair with recovery toy games
stop_conditions: Block if payment.outcome-unknown routes to automatic retry, replay calls mutable/external systems, or two dispositions remain valid for the same precedence-complete facts.

steps.name: Invoke Plan
stop_conditions: Block if the plan crosses the run-folder write scope, promotes candidate semantics, or omits fixtures and validation commands.

steps.name: Final Interrogation and Refine synthesis
convergence_criteria: All required model deliverables exist or name an exact blocking owner and reason.
Critical negative controls pass and no claim exceeds its evidence level.
The next plan is non-executed and preserves design, ontology, runtime, and promotion gates.
stop_conditions: Do not mark pass when a critical identity, disposition, precedence, authority, or unknown-effect question remains unresolved.

gates.condition: The persisted REFINE-DISPATCH.json must pass the canonical schema and semantic validator before any stage executes.
The operator explicitly confirms the displayed Refine strategy, ten native stages, and one bounded adversarial helper.
Every canonical stage returns a native stage receipt with its artifact or an exact blocked reason; freeform fallback prose is not a pass.
External research runs only after a stage names a concrete missing context and the operator separately approves one bounded pass.

The final model includes identities, state transitions, closed dispositions, precedence, typed contracts, owner matrix, invariants, forbidden topologies, counterexamples, ontology/design delta, and a non-executed plan.

The recommended helper returns its adversarial artifact and terminal lifecycle receipt, or the missing helper is recorded as explicit residue and the final result cannot claim independent falsification.
The run grants no lifecycle, ontology, canonical-definition, runtime, ARE, ACI, effect, publication, or promotion authority and writes only its refinement evidence folder.
Final synthesis starts only after stages s01 through s09 and the helper lifecycle have terminal receipts, including explicit block or residue where applicable.
